elements.text: People have been watching meteor showers for thousands of years. Meteors, or "shooting stars," look like streaks of light in the night sky. Even though they are called "stars," they are actually space rocks that are burning up in the air around Earth. A meteor shower occurs when Earth passes through patches of space rocks. When this happens, a number of shooting stars flash across the sky.

There are meteor showers that happen every year as Earth passes through the same patches of space rocks. Many people enjoy watching these annual meteor showers. For example, star-gazers look forward to the Perseid meteor shower every August.

To see a meteor shower, you must go outside in the early morning, before the sun comes up. It's best to go far away from city lights, which make it harder to see meteors. Then just lie back and look up at the sky. You're likely to see quite a show!

elements.text: Mosaics are pictures made by placing little colored pieces of stone or glass close together. They have been used in artwork for thousands of years. Mosaics are very sturdy, so they last a long time without breaking. They can even be used to make floors. In fact, some mosaic floors have been around since ancient times. The pictures in these mosaics can tell us about people from long ago.

You don't have to be a great artist to make a mosaic. To start, draw a design on a flat piece of wood. Then, glue pieces of colored stone or glass to the wood. You should use different colored pieces to color in each part of your design. Make sure you leave a bit of space between all the pieces. After the glue dries, you can spread grout, a type of cement, into the spaces. Once the grout dries, you will have a beautiful mosaic!

elements.text: Stand-up paddleboarding is a sport that lets people stand and move on top of the water. Paddleboarders stand on a board that looks a lot like a surfboard. But unlike surfers, paddleboarders don't have to ride on ocean waves. They use a long paddle to push themselves across the water, almost like a rowboat. So stand-up paddleboarding can be done on calm water, such as on a lake.

The most important thing for stand-up paddleboarding is balance. To keep from falling, you place both feet in the middle of the board with your toes pointed forward. You should also keep your back perfectly straight. If you lean to one side, you might fall into the water. Once you're balanced, try not to move your feet or body around. Just use the paddle to propel yourself forward and glide across the water.

Most modern archery targets are round and have different colored rings on the target. Hitting the ring in the center of the target is hard, so this scores the most points. But hitting the rings farther out from the center is easier. Therefore, those rings are worth fewer points. So, the more accurate an archer's aim is, the more points the archer earns.

elements.text: In the 1760s, a mapmaker pasted a world map onto a piece of wood, and then he cut out the countries in pieces. He didn't know it at the time, but he had just made the first jigsaw puzzle!

After the glue dries, you can spread grout, a type of cement, into the spaces. Once the grout dries, you will have a beautiful mosaic!
